name: Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelectionThunk
signature: void Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelectionThunk(UiListWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Vtable slot (0x007716A4) of a Ui_Object-derived list window: when the owner-active gate 0x0062AF84 reports true it forwards the call unchanged to Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelection, otherwise it does nothing.
evidence: The slot sits in the Ui_Object vtable next to Ui_Object_SetNamedDrawParam and maybe_Ui_Node_Finalize. Disassembly of the gate 0x0062AF84 shows it is a getter (self->f_38->f_08->u8_44 & 1), so the wrapper only forwards when the owning object is active; the callee is the already-named Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelection (0x002B1B2C), so the thunk wording is right.

name: maybe_Actor_BindSubObjects
summary: Stores the owner pointer at self+0x3570 and then hands the same owner to four embedded sub-objects at self+0x204, self+0x288, self+0xAB8 and self+0xBC8, i.e. a bind pass that wires a freshly created object to its owner.
evidence: No readable C exists (decomp/readable/recovered is empty), so this was read from asm/text/text_002C0048.s: str r1,[r4,#0x3570], then bl 0x258418(self+0x204, owner), bl 0x2D89EC(self+0x288, owner), bl 0x454250(self+0xAB8, owner) and a tail call on self+0xBC8. The address is not in decomp/xref.json and no rodata/data word points at it, so it has neither a direct caller nor a vtable slot; the 'Actor' prefix stays a guess (one callee is named Ui_ListView_BindDataSource, which does not fit an actor).

name: Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7617EC
signature: void Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7617EC(FieldMarker* self, void* argument, int c)

evidence: The installed vtable 0x007617EC is the Field_Marker vtable: its slots are Field_Marker_DeletingDtor (0x002F3100), Field_Marker_UpdateChild, Field_Marker_ApplyTransform, Field_Marker_UpdatePickupState and Field_Marker_OnEvent. Field_Marker_Ctor is already taken by 0x004C8384 (a different variant that sets +0x58/+0x5C to 0xFF), so the vtable address keeps the two apart.

name: Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7618A8
signature: void Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7618A8(FieldMarker* self, void* argument, int c)
summary: Constructor of the second Field_Marker variant (vtable 0x007618A8): base constructor 0x0044CAB4, vtable plus secondary table at self+0x258, id halfword -1 at +0x2EC, and +0x2EE/+0x2EF/+0x2F0 cleared.

name: Field_HorseAction_Ctor_vt7625D4
summary: Derived field-action constructor: base-constructs through Field_ActorAction_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x007625D4, a horse-action vtable whose slots call the model's vtable+0x84/+0x88 with the inline motion name "Hors...".
evidence: It is a constructor, not a factory: base Field_ActorAction_CtorBase then *self = 0x007625D4. That vtable's slot +0x08 (0x002FB430) loads self->f_28 and calls its vtable+0x84 with the inline string at 0x002FB444 ('Hors...'), and its deleting dtor is the adjacent 0x002FB480, so the class is a horse action. Field_HorseAction_Ctor (0x0036C54C) already exists, hence the vtable suffix.

name: Field_ActorTurnAction_Ctor
summary: Minimal derived action constructor: base-constructs through Field_ActorAction_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x007656EC, the actor turn-action vtable whose update slot is Field_ActorAction_Update.

name: Field_Action_Nut_Ctor

name: maybe_Party_UpdateMemberConditionFlag

name: Ui_TwoListWindow_UpdateChildSelection
summary: Propagates the window's selected id (signed byte at self+0x64) to its two child widgets at self+0x130/self+0x134: each child's vtable+0x1C reports its id, and the child's vtable+0x0C receives whether it is the selected one.
evidence: The readable C is truncated to a single call, so I read the disassembly: it calls 0x0029126C(self), then loops i<2 over the children at self+0x130/self+0x134, asks each child's vtable+0x1C for its id, compares it with the signed byte self+0x64 and passes the boolean to the child's vtable+0x0C. The vtable slot 0x00763E80 sits next to Ui_TwoListWindow_Init (0x00329AFC), so the class is Ui_TwoListWindow, not a generic window.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_DestroyTransitionMember

name: maybe_Field_IsNotPaused

name: maybe_Camera_PickLayerAtPoint
signature: u32 maybe_Camera_PickLayerAtPoint(CameraStack* self, u32* out, u32 x, u32 y, u32 extra)
